# gitmoap_repository_labels (Data Source)

List the labels a scope defines. Returns every label the repository itself defines, in alphabetical order of key. Labels defined by the groups above it are not included, though its work items can carry them. Anyone who can see the repository's work items may list them — on a public repository, without signing in.

The token needs `issue:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Autocomplete fragment — keeps labels whose key or description contains it, ignoring case

### Read-Only

- `repository_labels` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repository_labels))

<a id="nestedatt--repository_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repository_labels`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `title` (String) Its display name, free to change; absent when it shows its key.
